description: Opt-in automerge for repositories whose own test jobs are required status checks. Extend it after the default preset with "github>Giskard-AI/.github:automerge".

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security-fix PRs skip the 7-day wait, so they must not also skip review: a compromised maintainer can publish a malicious version together with an advisory against the previous one.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch and minor updates of development dependencies once CI passes. They get their own group because Renovate only automerges a group when every update in it is automergeable.

Automerge pinning GitHub Actions to the SHA of their current tag once CI passes. Digest updates are excluded: with SHA pins, a new digest for the same tag means the tag was moved to another commit (the tj-actions attack path), and the 7-day wait does not help because the attacker controls the commit date.
